proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8249-2 Section 2 *pucchaḍa explicitly includes Nepali puchar, Gujarati puchṛũ and northern puchaṛ tail; the r-bearing survey forms select this extended branch. Exact survey form pucʰār is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
